text:
alex: quick heads-up — planning to cut today's release at 18:00 PST. I've got a small batch of PRs that need fast eyes for tagging / changelog / backports. Can someone take a look?

alex: PR list:
```
#4212 runtime: avoid deadlock on KV init (needs review + tag)
#4218 docs: changelog entry for batching tweak (changelog edit + sign-off)
#4220 tests: backport quantize test fix to release-1.x (needs backport PR)
```

alex: ideally want all approvals + green CI by 17:30 so I can queue the cut. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: on it — will review #4212 and #4218 in the next 30m. if #4212 is a code change we should run a quick perf smoke after merge. :eyes:

joel: I can take #4220 backport, will open the backport PR and mark it WIP if I run into conflicts. planning to finish before 16:45.

rachel: I saw the changelog draft in #4218, I'll tidy the wording and add the component tag (runtime/batching). can we keep the changelog entry to one sentence + impact note?

ci-bot: CI status — #4212: checks/ci/unit passed, checks/ci/integration queued; #4218: checks/ci/docs passed; #4207 (unrelated) failing.

maya: quick note on #4212 — I left one small comment re: mutex scope, but LGTM otherwise. not blocking release if patched in a follow-up, but prefer patch now.

joel: backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4221 (WIP), hitting one conflict in test_utils, will resolve and ping.

alex: awesome, thanks all. if CI for #4212 finishes green and maya approves, i'll merge and tag. tagging checklist for me: merge -> run release script -> update release notes with rachel's text -> create cut branch. ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:

rachel: added final changelog text in #4218, moved under "Runtime Improvements" and added impact note.

ci-bot: CI update — #4212 integration checks passed. All required checks green for #4212 and #4218.

alex: perfect — merging #4212 now. queueing cut script for 18:00 PST. will post final cut notification once live. thanks everyone! :rocket:
